search_name: Raid: Shadow Legends EarnLab offer guide
primary_seo_intent: Guide the reader through each offerwall task safely, explain the important game systems and elements they will interact with, and help them decide whether the offer is worth completing.
target_user: US Android user who has not installed the game before.
original_task_list:
Starter tasks:
* Register and start playing the game - 370 points
* Complete the tutorial - 37 points
* Fight 20 battles within 24 hours - 89 points

Early account level tasks:
* Reach Level 15 within 3 days - 111 points
* Reach Level 30 within 4 days - 444 points

Hero upgrade tasks:
* Upgrade a hero to 5 stars within 3 days - 185 points
* Upgrade 3 heroes to 5 stars within 5 days - 740 points
* Upgrade a hero to 6 stars within 10 days - 1,110 points
* Upgrade 5 heroes to 5 stars within 14 days - 1,850 points
* Upgrade 3 heroes to 6 stars within 21 days - 5,920 points

Purchase tasks:
* Make any purchase - 2,220 points. Can be repeated daily, 1 time per 24 hours
* Purchase Silver 500k Pack for $9.99 - 11,100 points
* Purchase the Daily Gem Pack for $9.99 - 11,100 points
* Purchase a Sacred Daily Pack for $29.99 - 25,900 points
* Purchase the Beginner Progress Pack for $49.99 - 44,400 points. Eligible only if purchased after Day 7
* Purchase Box of Gems for $29.99 - 37,000 points. Eligible only if purchased after Day 30

Sacred Shard tasks:
* Open 2 Sacred / Yellow Shards - 2,220 points
* Open 4 Sacred / Yellow Shards - 5,920 points
* Open 6 Sacred / Yellow Shards - 16,280 points
* Open 8 Sacred / Yellow Shards - 28,120 points

Late account level tasks:
* Reach Level 50 within 21 days - 14,800 points
* Reach Level 60 within 35 days - 37,000 points
* Reach Level 70 within 60 days - 125,800 points

Total possible points from listed tasks: 372,716 points

notes: The prompt specified EarnLab, United States, Android, and a first-time user who has not installed Raid before.
The task list is the only payout and deadline source for this artifact.
